findings.summary: Dedupe lookup key (event.id) does not match insert key (refund.id), breaking idempotency
findings.scenario: Stripe delivers event {id: 'evt_1', data: {object: {id: 're_1', ...}}}. First call: lookup('evt_1') fails, applies refund, inserts 're_1'. Second delivery of same event: lookup('evt_1') fails again because table has 're_1', not 'evt_1'. Refund applied twice, customer double-credited.

tests_mapping.behavior: Duplicate events are skipped and return 'duplicate'
First event is processed and returns 'processed'
